conviction_note: A small net positive. Q3 revenue probably clears a disputed and falling consensus (four estimates span HK$6.03-6.89B, the low end implying -16% QoQ), and expectations were cut hard into the print (-20% in 20 days, JPM cut its target the day before, a current-quarter EPS estimate cut 13% in 7 days). Against that, Q4 quarter-to-date volume looks weak (HKEX's October ADT was HK$180.7B against HK$201.9B in September; Robinhood was flat), so the Q4 commentary is the likely drag. Futu sold its Q4 2025 beat (-6.3%) and bought a 22% Q2 revenue beat for only +3%, so p_up is 52, not higher. The findings sum to +0.30 and the scaled number is +0.24; the two agree.

findings.finding: The Q3 revenue bar is low against the volume evidence. The four consensus figures (HK$6.03B, 6.34B, 6.59B, 6.89B) imply -4% to -16% QoQ from Q2's HK$7.20B. Futu's Q2 mix was brokerage HK$3.36B on HK$6.42T of volume (78% US stocks, 18% HK), interest HK$3.12B and other HK$0.72B. Q3 US retail volume rose about 4% QoQ (Robinhood), HK cash turnover fell 12% QoQ (HKEX), the margin balance ended Q2 at HK$95.1B (+31% QoQ, which lifts the Q3 average), and HK equity issuance was a Q3 record. Together these point to revenue near HK$6.8-7.2B, a beat of about 3-16% depending on which bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A 22% Q2 revenue beat bought +3.0% (baseline, 2026-08-20). A 14% Q3 2025 EPS beat bought -0.5%. A small Q4 2025 EPS beat sold -6.3%. Futu pays little for reported-quarter beats.
findings.why_not_priced: The bar is thin (2 analysts on Yahoo) and was cut further in the last 7 days (EPS 29.93 to 26.15). If the market expected a beat, those estimates would not be falling and the stock would not be at a 52-week low on 8x trailing earnings. But beats are the base case on this name (it beat by 22% last quarter), so part of this is expected.
findings.independence: Q3 volume inputs come from Robinhood's Q3 release (https://finviz.com/news/409270/robinhood-reports-third-quarter-2026-results) and HKEX's Q3 results (https://www.chinadailyhk.com/article/642355). Those are filed separately below as findings 2 and 3, and this finding shares their data. Consensus sources: Yahoo, Investing.com, Earnings Whispers.

findings.finding: Robinhood's Q3 2026 equity notional volume was a record $992B, +53% YoY and +4% QoQ from Q2's $956B. Options contracts were a record 905M (+17% QoQ from 774M), and the margin book a record $22.1B. US-stock retail trading, 78% of Futu's Q2 volume, did not slow in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Futu's trading-volume line drove the Q2 record and a +3% reaction; no per-line history beyond that.
findings.why_not_priced: Q3 consensus revenue at HK$6.03-6.59B implies brokerage falling well below Q2 in a quarter when US retail volume rose. That the estimates did not move with Robinhood's print suggests the transmission is not modelled. It is a proxy: Futu's clients are Asian investors trading US stocks, not Robinhood's.
findings.independence: The Q2 figure comes from Robinhood's Q2 release (https://www.barchart.com/story/news/3534009/robinhood-reports-second-quarter-2026-results). It is a proxy, not company-confirmed.
findings.link: Same product, US-listed equities and options for retail. US stocks were HK$5.02T of Futu's HK$6.42T Q2 volume (78%). The customer bases do not overlap.

findings.finding: HKEX's Q3 2026 headline cash-market average daily turnover fell 11% YoY and 12% QoQ from the record Q2 (results 2026-11-06). HK stocks were HK$1.17T of Futu's HK$6.42T Q2 volume (18%), so the HK leg of Futu's brokerage was down sequentially.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and has probably been absorbed into the falling estimates. It is filed so the HK weakness is weighed against the US strength in findings 1 and 2.

findings.finding: Expectations were reset into the print. FUTU is -19.9% over 20 days and -14.2% over 5 days to a 52-week low (55% below the high, 8.2x trailing P/E). JPMorgan cut its target from $122 to $103 on 2026-11-18. Yahoo's current-quarter EPS estimate fell from HK$29.93 to HK$26.15 in the last 7 days, and Investing.com reports EPS estimates down 12.65% in two months. The fall tracked the Hang Seng Tech index (-3.02% on 2026-11-13) and Fed-hike fears more than anything company-specific.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the May 2026 penalty crash (-27.5%) the stock fell another -4.8% on the Q1 print (2026-05-28), so a low base did not by itself produce a bounce. In Q2 a beat from a lower base bought +3%.
findings.why_not_priced: The run-down is the price. The point is that the real bar now sits at or below consensus. If the market held a high bar, the stock would be near its $123 200-day average and estimates would not be falling. The driver is macro (China tech, US rates), which a good print does not remove, so the size is small.
findings.independence: Yahoo EPS trend (https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/FUTU/analysis) and Investing.com preview (https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/futu-set-to-report-earnings-as-estimate-cuts-test-rally-hopes-93CH-5036459), both 2026-11-18. The baseline tape is a different source.

HKEX's October 2026 ADT was HK$180.7B against HK$201.9B in September and a ten-month average of HK$263.8B. Robinhood's October equity notional was $325B (+1% MoM; ADV $14.8B, -4% MoM), against Q3's monthly average of about $331B. findings.finding: The 800,000 net-new-funded-account target for 2026 looks reachable and likely to be kept. H1 delivered 477k (225k in Q1, 252k in Q2), so H2 needs about 323k, or about 160k a quarter, against 'moderating' Q3 adds and CAC that rose in July within the HK$2,500-3,000 guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The target was reaffirmed at the Q1 and Q2 calls, which drew -4.8% and +3.0%. Account adds were not the line those reactions turned on.
findings.why_not_priced: A cut would be the negative surprise. The arithmetic says a cut is unlikely, but some investors may fear one after the mainland wind-down (13% of funded accounts are sell-only). Keeping the target is mostly expected, so the size is small.

findings.finding: About $382M remains on the $800M ADS buyback, which runs to 2027-12-31 ($418M was used by late May 2026). With the stock at a 52-week low on 8.2x P/E, a new or faster buyback, or a dividend, is a possible capital-return item on the call. That is inference: no announcement was found.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the May 2026 crash Futu disclosed $160M of repurchases (2026-05-23), and the stock rebounded to $107.70 (Chinese-language summary of the TIKR article).
findings.why_not_priced: No analyst preview found mentions capital return. It is speculative, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Q2 release, 2026-08-20 (https://finviz.com/news/383934/futu-announces-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results), confirms the program size and use.

findings.finding: The CSRC's proposed penalty of about RMB1.85B (May 2026) was accrued in Q1 and still awaits a final decision. Existing mainland clients (about 13% of funded accounts, about 17% of client assets) are in a two-year sell- or withdraw-only wind-down, so Q3 and Q4 carry continuing mainland outflows. Management said in August the 'bulk of the impact' was absorbed in Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The penalty news drew -27.5% (2026-05-22). The Q1 print with the accrual drew -4.8% (2026-05-28).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. What is unknown is the size of Q3 mainland outflows in the net-asset-inflow figure, and whether a final decision differs from the accrual.
findings.independence: Mainland share of client assets: https://www2.yicaiglobal.com/news/chinese-mainland-client-assets-account-for-17-of-futus-total-ceo-says ; wind-down terms: https://www.financemagnates.com/forex/analysis/china-just-gave-offshore-brokers-two-years-to-exit-the-mainland/

findings.finding: The Fed raised rates 25bp on 2026-09-16, and the HKMA base rate rose to 4.25%. One-month HIBOR rose to 2.95% in mid-September, a near three-month high. Interest income was 43% of Futu's Q2 revenue, so the higher rates support Q3 and Q4 interest income on margin loans and client cash.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Interest income rose 36.5% YoY in Q2. No per-line reaction history found.
findings.why_not_priced: The same rate fears are what sold the stock (Fed-hike expectations hit HK tech on 2026-11-11 to 11-13), while a broker's net interest margin benefits from them. This is macro transmission the company has not confirmed, so it is small.
findings.independence: IBKR's Q3 net interest income rose 19% YoY (https://www.financemagnates.com/forex/brokers/interactive-brokers-raises-dividend-71-as-net-interest-income-offsets-trading-slowdown/).

findings.finding: At the Q2 call (2026-08-20), management said Q3-to-date trading volume was 'down modestly' sequentially, net new funded accounts were 'moderating', CAC rose in July, and the bulk of the regulatory outflow (mid-single-digit % of client assets) was absorbed in Q2. This is the only statement found from inside the quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock rose +3.0% on the day this was said, alongside a 22% beat.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and built into consensus. It is filed because softer Q3 net adds and higher CAC are the likely reported-quarter disappointments, against the revenue beat.

baseline_tension: The small positive cuts against the +3.92 downside skew and the -20% 20-day run-down. It rests on a low, disputed bar and on expectations already reset, while the drawdown's macro driver and soft October activity argue the other way, so p_up stays near 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (disputed bar, four sources from HK$6.03B to HK$6.89B): the consensus_bar finding was capped from +0.8 to +0.6.

Rule 7 (skew +3.92 downside paid against a positive lean): the expectations finding was cut from +0.8 to +0.6, because the drawdown's macro driver is not something the print removes; the short is not crowded, so the negatives were not shrunk.
Rule 1 (Futu pays little for reported-quarter beats: +3.0% on a 22% revenue beat, -6.3% on a Q4 2025 beat): p_up moved from 53 to 52; abs_move stays 6.0.

Untrustworthy-history rule: the base rate was rebuilt from confirmed print dates only (2025-05-29, 2025-08-20, 2025-11-18, 2026-03-12, 2026-05-28, 2026-08-20; median |move| about 3.9%), excluding 2026-04-02 and 2026-05-22, before setting abs_move. This was done in the draft as well, so it changed no number.
Rule 5 (proxies): Robinhood, IBKR, HKEX and rates were already filed small as proxies; unchanged.
